diagnosis.what_happened: Stale legacy validation reports were left on disk during graduation or stage transitions.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Failing to rename or relocate legacy validation reports caused recursive validation guards to be triggered by stale data.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: A physical file mutation should have been executed to de-index legacy validation reports.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Leaving legacy state files in active deliverable directories corrupts the current validation state.

desired_behavior: During graduation or stage completion, execute a physical file mutation to de-index legacy validation reports (e.g., rename '03_deliverables/legacy_validation/validation_report.json' to 'validation_report.stale.json').
generalization: Always decontaminate persistent directories by de-indexing or removing legacy validation reports to prevent false-positive validation loops.
